'''Corellian Engineering Corporation decks''' are constructed Star Wars CCG lists published on the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] GeoCities site (CollegePark/Plaza/9433 and later plarathas). The surviving index listed the same Classic titles from 9 July 2000 through the 2009 Yahoo shutdown. Classic Dark Side stayed empty on every capture; Wayback did not keep extra Light or Dark files beyond these three.

Classic lists keep the published title, the author handle, the card list, and a [[GEMP importable decklist|GEMP Importable deck]] download.

A parent catalog of published 60s is [[Decklists]].

== Young Jedi ==

The same Deck Designs index listed two [[Young Jedi]] lists (a different Decipher game) next to the Classic Star Wars 60s, both posted as Gold 31 ([[Alex Alcalde]]): ''Wizards!'' (Jedi) and ''All Droids All the time!'' (Sith). Archived copies:

* [https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/decks/jedi1.html Wizards!] (geocities.ws) · [https://web.archive.org/web/20011202101302/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/decks/jedi1.html jedi1.html] (Wayback, 2 December 2001)
* [https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/decks/sith1.html All Droids All the time!] (geocities.ws) · [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009020148/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/decks/sith1.html sith1.html] (Wayback, 9 October 2026)
